purpose: Rolling-window z-score and STL-style seasonal decomposition anomaly detection on synthetic payment volume time series. Control chart (UCL/LCL 3σ), trend/seasonal/residual panel decomposition, anomaly flag table with severity, naïve ARIMA-lite 30-period forecast. Chains from SIM-03 (Basel RWA Scenario Modeler). Feeds RCA-01 (FRTB IMA). DORA Art.17 monitoring / EBA GL/2021/03 operational risk / PSD2 Art.96 fraud reporting.
